rows.text: The Assembly reports that 'TONGA'S Legislative Assembly will hold its first session on the 13th of January 2011. This was announced by the Speaker of the House, Lord Lasike', and that during the first sitting members 'will take their oaths of office starting with the Speakers to be followed by the Prime Ministers, Ministers, Nobles and People's Representatives'.
rows.uncertainty: A prospective styling of Lasike as Speaker before the first sitting, and the only record found of a planned Speaker's oath. The item is undated, so no structured date is stored; it does not date his royal appointment, and no record of the oath being taken was found.
